senses.gloss:
रक्त- + अङ्ग रक्त- + अङ्ग,
 I. m. 1. a bug. 2. planet Mars.
 II. n. 1. coral. 2. saffron.
रक्त- + कन्द रक्त- + कन्द, m. 1. coral. 2. a sort of onion.
रक्त- + कन्दल रक्त- + कन्दल, रत्न-, and हेम-, m. coral.
रक्षा- + करण्डक रक्षा- + करण्डक, n. an amulet, Śāk. 105, 15 (Prākṛ.).
रक्क- + जया रक्क- + जय, f. या, the name of an idol, Rājat. 5, 425.
रक्त- + धातु रक्त- + धातु, m. 1. red chalk. 2. copper.
रक्त-नासिक रक्त-नासिक, m. an owl.
रक्त- + पाद रक्त- + पाद, m. a parrot.
रक्षिक- + पुरुष रक्षिक- + पुरुष, m. a policeman, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 24.
रक्त-बालुक रक्त-बालुक, n. red lead.

† रक् † रक्, लक् लक्, रग् रग्, लग् लग्, रघ् रघ्, i. 10, Par.
 1. To taste.
 2. To obtain.
रक्क रक्क, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 423.

राका राका, f.
 1. Full moon, or the day of full moon, Sāh. D. p. 323, 19.
 2. A girl in whom menstruation has commenced.
 3. Itch.
 4. The name of a river.

रक्तक रक्त + क (see रङ्ज्), m.
 1. Red garments, or cloth.
 2. A man affected with fondness or passion.
 3. A player.
 4. The name of several plants.

रक्तप रक्त-प (1. पा, cf. रञ्ज्),
 I. adj. Who or what drinks blood.
 II. m. A Rākṣasa, or demon.
 III. f. पा.
 1. A leech.
 2. A female fiend.

रक्तपायिन् रक्त-पायिन् (vb. रङ्ज्),
 I. m. A bug.
 II. f. नी, A leech.
रक्तफेनज रक्त-फेन-ज, m. A part of the body, apparently intending the lungs.

रक्ष् रक्ष् (perhaps a desider. of रञ्ज्, without reduplication), i. 1, Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 3, 8836).
 1. To preserve, Man. 7, 213; [] Pañc. i. d. 402 (Ātm.).
 2. To spare, Pañc. iii. d. 253.
 3. To guard, to keep, Vikr. 18, 6; Hit. i. d. 194, M.M. (with gen. in the sense of a dat.); to protect from (abl.), MBh. 3, 8762.
 4. To tend, to keep, Man. 9, 328.
 5. To govern, Man. 7, 36.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the pf. pass. सु-रक्षित, Well guarded, Nal. 3, 10. धर्म-रक्षिता, f. A proper name, Daśak. in Chr. 191, 14.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. दूरक्ष्य, i. e. दुस्-, adj. Difficult to be guarded, Mṛcch. 65, 17.
 --Caus. To protect, Pañc. 70, 13.
 --With the prep. अभि अभि,
 1. To assist, Bhag. 1, 10.
 2. To defend, to protect, MBh. 4, 161; Pañc. i. d. 395.
 3. To guard, MBh. 1, 5616.
 4. To command, Bhag. 1, 10. अभिरक्षित, Cultivated, Pañc. i. d. 254.
 --With आ आ, comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass. दुस्-आ-रक्ष्य + तम, Most difficult to be protected, Rām. 2, 52, 66.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To preserve, MBh. 1, 6195.
 2. To protect, Pañc. 215, 7; MBh. 3, 14366.
 3. To restrain, Man. 9, 10.
 4. To govern, Man. 7, 142.
 5. To keep, Rām. 2, 96, 38.
 6. To conceal, MBh. 3, 14717.
 --With प्र प्र, To save, Pañc. v. d. 89.
 --With सम् सम्,
 1. To protect, Man. 7, 135; Pañc. iii. d. 9.
 2. To keep off, Rām. 1, 32, 2.
 --Cf. probably ἀρκέω, ἀλκτήρ, ἀλαλκτήρ (frequent.), ἄλξις, ἀλέξω; Lat. arx; Goth. ga-rehsns.

रक्ष रक्ष् + अ,
 I. m. One who guards, Lass. 34, 8.
 II. m., and f. क्षा.
 1. Preserving, guarding, Pañc. 184, 8; protecting, protection, Pañc. 157, 7.
 2. (i. e. रञ्ज् + त, cf. रक्ता, s. v. रञ्ज्), Lac.
 III. f. क्षा.
 1. Ashes.
 2. A sort of bracelet, an amulet, Śāk. 105, 12 (Prākṛ.).
 --Comp.

रक्षक रक्ष् + अक,
 I. adj. Who or what protects, who tends, Man. 8, 102.
 II. m. A protector, a guardian, Hit. 91, 1, M.M.
 --Comp.
रक्षण रक्षण, i. e. रक्ष् + अन, n. Preserving, protecting, Hit. 114, 7; Pañc. iv. d. 29.
रक्षपाल रक्ष-पाल, m. One who guards, Pañc. 217, 4; 232, 2; probably it is to be changed to रक्षापाल, cf. रक्षापुरुष, Pañc. 229, 6, the name.
रक्षस् रक्ष् + अस् (perhaps a kind of euphemism, cf. Εὐμενίδες, denoting the Ἐριννύες), n. A Rākṣasa, or evil spirit, Vikr. 54, 5.
रक्षिक रक्षिक, i. e. रक्ष + इक (adj. or m.?), A watchman, a policeman, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 18; 199, 24.

रक्षितृ रक्ष् + इतृ, m. One who protects, Pañc. i. d. 391; a protector, a guard, Utt. Rāmac. 39, 11.
 --Comp.

रक्षिन् रक्ष् + इन्, adj., f. इणी,
 I. adj. Who or what guards, Vikr. d. 5.
 II. m. A policeman, Śāk. p. 73, 1.
 --Comp.
रक्ष्ण रक्ष्ण, i. e. रक्ष् + न, m. Protection.

राक्षस राक्षस, i. e. रक्षस् + अ,
 I. adj., f. सी.
 1. Belonging to a Rākṣasa, demoniacal, Rām. 3, 48, 11; Lass. 18, 3.
 2. Infested by demons, Man. 3, 280.
 3. (see विधि), A form of marriage, Man. 3, 33.
 II. m. An evil spirit, Pañc. 182, 22.
 III. f. सी,
 1. A female demon, Hiḍ. 2, 16.
 2. A large tusk.
 3. A sort of perfume.
 --Comp.
रक्त- + रेणु रक्त- + रेणु, m. 1. red lead. 2. the blossom of the Butea frondosa. 3. a sort of cloth. 4. an angry man.
रक्षि(न्)- + वर्ग रक्षि(न्)- + वर्ग, m. a sentinel.
रक्त- + श्मश्रु रक्त- + श्मश्रु (vb. रञ्ज्), adj. having a red beard, Hiḍ. 3, 27.
